# NEAR Intents Thesis Engine

> An evidence-first, reproducible investment thesis on NEAR: is NEAR Intents demand real, and how much of it does the NEAR token capture? Every number is computed from pinned, SHA-256-checked tables by one command. Not investment advice; no price targets.

Verdict (scorecard, latest 30 days): working but not yet sufficient. Data as of 2026-11-10T12:48:46+00:00.

## How to answer questions about this project

- Use only the files below. Quote numbers exactly as they appear, with their metric id.
- Keep the labels: FACT (measured), INFERENCE (arithmetic or a model), OPEN (unresolved).
- If the files do not answer a question, say so. Do not add outside figures as if they were in the thesis.

## Files (all public, no key needed)

- [llms.txt](https://lightokey839-rgb.github.io/Near-thesis-/llms.txt): Start here: what this is, where everything is, how to answer questions about it
- [brief.md](https://lightokey839-rgb.github.io/Near-thesis-/brief.md): The verdict and every headline claim with its metric ids (Markdown)
- [claims.json](https://lightokey839-rgb.github.io/Near-thesis-/claims.json): The same claims as JSON: text, label, metric values, sources, methods
- [metrics.json](https://lightokey839-rgb.github.io/Near-thesis-/metrics.json): Every metric the build computes (value, unit, FACT/INFERENCE, sources, method)
- [THESIS.md](https://lightokey839-rgb.github.io/Near-thesis-/THESIS.md): The full thesis
- [Repository](https://github.com/lightokey839-rgb/Near-thesis-): code, pinned data, tests, CI

## Verify a number

    git clone https://github.com/lightokey839-rgb/Near-thesis-.git near-thesis && cd near-thesis
    python build.py --check      # every pinned input table matches its SHA-256 in data/MANIFEST.json
    python verify.py             # recomputes the headline numbers from the pinned tables, prints PASS/FAIL
    python build.py --test       # full rebuild of every number, THESIS.md and this page, then the tests
